remarks: Welcome to 30 Archer Lane, a tasteful 3-bedroom, 1.5 bath mid-century ranch on a sprawling 0.47-acre lot in the highly sought-after Mid-Ridges neighborhood. This one level home offers the perfect blend of timeless character and modern updates. The heart of the home features a remodeled eat-in kitchen that opens toward a spacious light filled living room & dining area anchored by a stylish corner fireplace. Additionally, off of the dining room is a private office and laundry room. On the opposite wing of this ranch you will find 3 bedrooms, one being a primary en-suite bedroom with ample closet space. Step outside onto the new composite patio which is ideal for relaxing in privacy and outdoor entertaining. Other notable features include public sewer, public water, and a 1 car attached garage. 30 Archer Lane is ideally located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, Whole-Foods, and is a short drive to downtown, but still retains the secluded and private feeling you've been looking for.
